indexdef: CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_low_store ON blinkit.store_inventory USING btree (store_id, quantity_on_hand) WHERE (quantity_on_hand <= reorder_level)
CREATE INDEX idx_items_product_order ON blinkit.order_items USING btree (product_id, order_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_items_substitute_order ON blinkit.order_items USING btree (substitute_product_id, order_id) WHERE (substitute_product_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_movements_restock_store_date ON blinkit.inventory_movements USING btree (store_id, moved_at) INCLUDE (product_id, quantity) WHERE (movement_type = 'RESTOCK'::text)

CREATE INDEX idx_movements_wastage_date ON blinkit.inventory_movements USING btree (moved_at) INCLUDE (product_id, movement_type, quantity) WHERE (movement_type = ANY (ARRAY['EXPIRY'::text, 'DAMAGE'::text]))
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_placed ON blinkit.orders USING btree (customer_id, placed_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_open_store ON blinkit.orders USING btree (store_id, placed_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['PLACED'::text, 'PACKING'::text, 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY'::text]))
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_pack_store ON blinkit.orders USING btree (store_id, order_id DESC) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['PLACED'::text, 'PACKING'::text]))
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_packing_id ON blinkit.orders USING btree (order_id) WHERE (status = 'PACKING'::text)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_placed ON blinkit.orders USING btree (placed_at DESC) INCLUDE (order_id, customer_id, store_id, status, total_amount)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_rider_placed ON blinkit.orders USING btree (rider_id, placed_at) WHERE (rider_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_store_placed ON blinkit.orders USING btree (store_id, placed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_riders_active_store ON blinkit.riders USING btree (store_id, rider_id) WHERE (status = 'ACTIVE'::text)
